rationale: The candidate preserves some high-level facts (20,000 t/year milk products; ~30 km distance to the cheese plant; ~1,100 t/year cheese produced in Rosendahl; milk is delivered and then sent to the cheesery; external warehouse near Epe) but introduces multiple incorrect place names (Gronau→Kronau/Kronen/etc., Rosendahl→'russische rosendal') which materially change location references. Because of these omissions, place-name errors, and hallucinated additions, the candidate does not faithfully preserve the reference's meaning.
